text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

QUEENSLAND - Nov 11 - Abbot Point - one vessel loading, 5 vessels due by 29/11, no delays. Dalrymple Bay - one vessel loading, 19 vessels due by 24/11, currently no delays, but delays of 1-3 days can be expected mid-November. Hay Point - one vessel loading, 12 vessels due by 24/11, no delays. Gladstone - R.G. Tanna - one vessel awaiting cargo, 17 vessels due by 2/12, no delays. Barney Point - 6 vessels due by 5/12, no delays. Brisbane - two vessels due by 29/11. Gordonstone - miners at Gordonstone mine returned to work 9/11 p.m., railings from the mine have recommenced to Gladstone. Further meeting expected between unions and management on 12/11, after which both parties will report back

NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Dyke 4+5 - 2 vessels loading, 1 waiting, 22 vessels due by 29/11, approx. 1 days delay. Kooragang - 2 vessels loading, no vessels waiting, 19 vessels due by 27/11, no delays. Port Kembla - one vessel loading, 14 vessels due by 12/12, no delays.

WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Dampier - Parker Point - 1 vessel loading, 2 due by 12/11. E.I. Island - 1 vessel due 15/11. Dampier lineup - 16 vessels due by 25/11. Maintenance shutdown at E.I. Island from 1300 hours 10/11 for 5 days. Port Walcott - one vessel loading, 4 vessels due by 25/11. Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) - Berth A - 1 vessel loading, 4 vessels due by 20/11. Berth B - 1 vessel loading, 4 vessels due by 18/11, 5 other vessels due with no ETA. Goldsworthy (Finucane Island) - 1 vessel loading, 1 due 13/11, 3 other vessels due by 24/11.

QUEENSLAND, Nov 13 - Mackay - one vessel loading wheat. Gladstone - four wheat vessels due by 25/11. Brisbane - one vessel loading wheat, 4 due by 20/11. New South Wales - Newcastle - five vessels due by 10/12. Port Kembla - one vessel loading wheat, 5 vessels due. Victoria - Geelong - three vessels due by 22/11. Portland - four vessels due by 15/12. South Australia - Port Pirie - no vessels due. Port Adelaide - one vessel loading wheat, vessel due. Thevenard - no vessels due. Port Lincoln - one wheat vessel due 14/11. Wallaroo - one vessel loading wheat. Ardrossan, Port Giles - no vessels due. Western Australia - Geraldton - one vessel loading wheat, 3 due by 25/11. Kwinana - one vessel loading wheat, 1 vessel in port, 7 due by 3/12. Albany - one wheat vessel due 15/11. Esperance - no vessels due.
